verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 is a viral disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, which spreads through respiratory droplets. There is no scientific evidence linking the spread of COVID-19 to 5G mobile networks or radio waves.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of evidence from international organizations (UN), scientific bodies (NCBI), major news agencies (AP News), and numerous fact-checking organizations (AFP Fact Check, Full Fact, etc.) confirms that there is no scientific basis for the claim. These sources consistently state that COVID-19 is a virus transmitted through respiratory droplets and cannot be spread by radio waves from 5G networks. The claim is a widely debunked conspiracy theory.
